description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

 Job Overview 
 We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test who is passionate about quality and test automation to join the TV & Web Player Developer Experience and Release Quality team. We own end-to-end testing, build systems, CI/CD, and the infrastructure and tooling behind them, so that player engineers have fast, reliable developer workflows and the clients that power Netflix playback in web browsers and on a huge range of TV and streaming devices ship quickly and with high quality.

 This role focuses on test automation, covering both feature and performance testing. You will develop the test strategy, automated tests for new player features as they are built, from core streaming to live events and ad-supported viewing; you will maintain our current automated test suites; you will make sure our players perform well across the wide variety of devices our members use; and you will lead innovation in how test automation gets developed in the first place, so that coverage keeps pace with a fast release cadence and the team trusts the results enough to block a merge or a release on them.

 About the Role 
 Partner with player engineers early in feature development to own the end-to-end and functional test strategy for new features: which member scenarios need coverage, which tests should gate a merge or release, and what test streams, data, and upstream support those scenarios depend on.
 Own performance testing: build automated performance tests and benchmarks (such as playback startup time, rebuffering, memory, CPU, and frame rate) across a representative range of TV devices, catch regressions before they ship, and help engineers find and fix their root causes.
 Innovate on how test automation is developed: build frameworks, harnesses, and reusable tooling, and apply AI-assisted approaches that make tests faster to write, easier to maintain, and more trustworthy. Engage with Netflix's test and developer tools teams to bring the latest capabilities into our workflows, and influence their roadmaps toward enhancements that support our testing needs.
 Build the tools that make realistic end-to-end test scenarios possible, such as utilities to manipulate test streams and services that provide reliable, repeatable test data, and partner with upstream teams to get the hooks and support those scenarios need.
 Own and improve test metrics (critical scenario coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, and performance baselines), and use them to drive priorities. Drive down flaky tests and known issues, reduce runtime, and retire tests that no longer change a decision.
 Work closely with teammates who own the build system and CI/CD pipelines so automated tests are integrated as reliable, well-understood quality gates.
 Support release readiness and live event readiness, clearly communicating quality, performance, and reliability risks and their impact to engineering, product, and release stakeholders, including participating in on-call rotations for player client releases.
 Validate playback quality and client stability through A/B test variant monitoring and metrics analysis prior to driving full production rollouts.
 Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values and you make sure every voice on the team is heard.
 
 What Sets You Apart 
 You have deep experience ensuring the quality of consumer web or device applications at scale, and you are highly proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript.
 You are an engineer first, with the software chops to build test frameworks, harnesses, and tooling from the ground up rather than only consuming what others build.
 You have a track record of improving how teams write tests, not just writing more of them, and you have applied AI tooling in a testing context to generate tests, triage failures, analyze flakiness, or close coverage gaps.
 You have hands-on experience with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Spinnaker, or GitHub Actions, and are comfortable debugging the pipelines your tests run in.
 You are curious about audio and video and how streaming works, including adaptive bitrate streaming, DRM, codecs, and browser media APIs such as MSE and EME.
 You understand the realities of browser and TV device diversity, and what it takes to prove consistent playback and performance across many device generations and capabilities.
 You have experience with performance testing and profiling of client applications, ideally on resource-constrained devices, and know how to produce stable, repeatable measurements that reliably catch regressions.
 You bring an analytical, data-driven approach to identifying root causes, and can reason through the interactions of client, network, and backend in a domain where playback failures are often emergent and hard to reproduce.
 You have exposure to A/B testing or experimentation workflows.
 You communicate clearly and build collaboration across boundaries, with player engineers on web and TV, fellow test and release engineers, product managers, and data science partners.
 
 Why Netflix? 
 Collaborate every day with a high performing team that values selflessness, inclusion, and candor.
 Make your impact on a product loved by hundreds of millions around the world.
 Work side by side with your team and partners in Los Gatos.
 Strong parental leave policy and family forming benefits.
  
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $266,000.00 - $442,000.00. 
 Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . 
 
 Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .
 
 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
 
 We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.
